changelog: v2.9.2 - Move Vertical info card from Dashboard to Settings -> Vertical tab (Dashboard now scrolls cleanly with mouse wheel). Replace modal messagebox after Print KOT / Quick Bill with a non-blocking toast so the dialog cannot be mistaken for the main window close. Sales 'Print Bill' now asks for confirmation before opening the browser. Initialize _current_page_key to prevent reload crash after first-run wizard. Live-verified: all 10 pages and 11 settings tabs build without exceptions.
